programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Majestic View Created by the Nature, Jeju
programme.desc: The natural environment of deep blue sea and steep cliffs under the azure sky makes a majestic view around the island of Jeju. The lava flowed from the volcano of the island created a spectacular landscape in corners of Jeju such as Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak and pillar-shaped cliffs on the coast. The heavenly combination between the sky, the ocean and the bold cliffs by the shore. Here, we present the mysterious land of Jeju.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Island of Wind and Stones
programme.desc: Experience a day in Seongeup Folk Village of Jeju, the island of wind and stones. Jeju has long been referred to samdado (island of three many) because it is abundant with wind, stones and women. The thatched houses in Jeju were wisely constructed with stones as soil is not sufficient, and in a way to embrace strong winds.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water

programme.desc: Jeongbang Waterfall in Jeju Island, or province is the Orient's only seaside fall which its waters drop directly into the sea, the form of which is pretty much rare worldwide.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The landscape of Jeju Island from which you are able to sees Mt. Sanbang

programme.desc: In Weolryong-ri, Jeju, you can see the Korea's only and single colony of cacti which are dashed from the tropical region riding on the ocean currents and grow wild.

programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.desc: When a volcanic erupted here in the shallow sea 1.8 million years ago, the fragmental matters spewed and piled up one by one neatly. programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The mysterious chimney made with lava gas, Hornito, Biyangdo, Jeju
programme.desc: The island in island which makes people get access to only on a very tiny boat in Jeju. Let's meet the Biyangdo Hornito which one is able to see the natural scenery unique to nonvolcanic islands

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The glistening white field of jewels, Hongjodangoe-haebin of udo, jeju
programme.desc: In the northern coast of Jeju, there are lots of sand beaches and sand dunes which are boastful of their milky color against the blue sea. Most of the beaches are ones consisted of weathered sandy shells but Hongjodangoe-haebin of Udo, Jeju is composed of red algae sand or honjodangoe, not weathered sandy shells.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Lost in the white flagrance, Natural Habitat for Crinum Lilies Rabbit Island's
programme.desc: Crinum lilies grow in the sand beach which the climate is mild and are distributed in Japan, China, India, Malaysia and Korea, However, the flowers grow naturally only in the Rabbit Island, Jeju in Korea. The crinum lilies there are also recognized for the purpose of academic research and are designated and protected as a natural monument.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : A giant crater formed in the flatland, Sangumburi Crater, Jeju
programme.desc: Worthy of an island formed by volcanic activity, Jeju Island has a lot of special and unique natural sceneries. Among them, there are tourist attractions which are rarely seen in the world. Unlike other craters, the Jeju Sangumburi Crater is a large one formed in a low flatland. Even though its ejecta is little and the inside of the crater is steep, its outside shows a gentle slope.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Jeju Batdam the black waves holding a life
programme.desc: Batdam, the field fences which are built by piling the stones around the edges of the field in Jeju Province. The fences total 22,000 kilometers in length, which boasts of its unique and beautiful landscape.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Korean horses which resemble Jeju Province Jeju Horses
programme.desc: Jeju Horses, the species indigenous to the region as a natural monument. The animals, which adapted themselves to the tough environment of Jeju Province contributed largely to the development of the province’s agricultural culture.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Sara-oreum, the LittleBaekrokdam Pond
programme.desc: The term, 'Oreum' refers to a parasitic volcano attached to Mount Halla. In Jeju Island, there are roughly 368 oreums.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.desc: The Seosokkak Estuary in the southern coast of Jeju Province is boastful of its unique magnificent scenery with the transparent water, the dense pine forest and the strange rocks and bizarre stones being in harmony one another.

programme.title: UNIDO Climate Adaptation and Industrial Resilience Forum 2026
programme.desc: Aligned with the UNIDO Climate Action Plan 2025–2029, the Global Climate Action Agenda and key outcomes from COP28, COP29 and COP30, the UNIDO Climate Adaptation and Industrial Resilience Forum 2026 aims to inform the co-design of climate-resilient industries of the future, through: 1.Strengthening of UNIDO’s role as a partner of choice to Member States in advancing industrial adaptation in the post-COP30 context, 2.Serving as a global public–private convening platform that positions adaptation as both a climate justice imperative and an investable opportunity, and that accelerates the provision of grants-based, concessional and private financing for innovative, scalable solutions that build industrial resilience. And 3.Supporting of countries and industries in co-creating actionable and investable adaptation pathways.

programme.title: SBI 6: 7th Plenary Session
programme.desc: The sixth meeting of the Subsidiary Body on Implementation (SBI-6) of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) is taking place from 16-19 February 2026 at the Headquarters of the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in Rome. The SBI meets between Conferences of the Parties (COPs) to undertake work in the areas of reviewing and enhancing implementation, strengthening the enabling conditions and effectiveness of the operations of the CBD.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, even the rarest – some of the most iconic creatures in the natural world. Many are familiar but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers.

programme.title: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Breaking off from mainland Africa 160 million years ago, refugee animals cast adrift on natural rafts arrived on the tropical shores of Madagascar.

programme.title: Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe: A land of myriad climates and terrains, within whose boundaries lie some of the most complex and beautiful habitats on the planet. This is Europe wild and thriving.

programme.title: Crocodile Kingdom
programme.desc: The crocodile is king of the wetland a tone of cold blooded monster with the most terrifying bite force on Earth. The product of a 100 million year ancestry, the 25 species around today are testament to the crocodile's supreme intelligence and adaptability.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Parmanu - The Story of Pokhran
programme.desc: Based on true events, Parmanu – The Story of Pokhran follows the journey of a dedicated IAS officer, Ashwat Raina, who leads a top-secret mission to conduct India’s first underground nuclear tests in 1998 at Pokhran, Rajasthan. Battling political opposition, espionage threats, and tight deadlines, the team works against all odds to place India on the world’s nuclear map. The film is a patriotic thriller about courage, strategy, and national honor.
